## Customer Story

**Customer:** Kavak — Latin America's largest used car marketplace

**Challenge:** High volume of customer inquiries about vehicle availability, financing, scheduling test drives, and transaction support overwhelming human agents

**Solution:** Autonomous concierge agent for automotive marketplace, handling customer inquiries, scheduling, and transaction support through natural conversation. The agent manages the full customer journey from initial inquiry to purchase completion.
